picks.title: When Allah Tests You With What You Love Most | #3 Stories from the Golden Generations of Islam #AMAU
picks.summary: What happens when Allah tests you with the one thing you thought you could never bear to lose? Your health. Your child. Your safety. Your strength. It is easy to speak about Sabr when life is calm. But what does patience actually look like when the trial becomes deeply personal? How do you stop grief from turning into resentment? How do you remain grateful when something precious is taken from you? And how do you protect your Iman when the pain feels overwhelming? picks.reason: Reflects on patience, grief, and faith through early Muslim trials.

picks.title: Poetry Unbound in Conversation — Haleh Liza Gafori

picks.reason: Conversation on Rumi's Islamic faith and universalist vision through poetry.

picks.title: The Greatest Opening,What Is Surah Al-Fatihah

picks.reason: Deep reflection on Surah Al-Fatihah's foundational meaning in Islamic faith.

picks.showTitle: Quran in a Year+ (with Imam Saif Morad)
picks.title: Day 338- Be Patient, But Don’t Be Passive | Ahkaf 33-35, Muhammad 1-11
picks.summary: in todays episode, we reflect on Allah’s command to the Prophet ﷺ to remain patient like the messengers of firm resolve and not to rush what Allah has not yet brought about.As we enter Surah Muḥammad, we explore how the Qur’an regulates even the most difficult human realities through revelation, authority, and the limits Allah has set. We also reflect on why Allah tests people through one another, why faith cannot be built upon following whoever appears strongest, and what it truly means to support the cause of Allah.
picks.reason: Reflects on patience, divine testing, and faith's foundation in Quranic verses.
